entries.title: Clearer records, a lighter reading experience
entries.summary: Labeled source dates, consistent category counts, separate date and venue-year sorting, and collection history. Weekly source-link checks and citation/star refreshes keep existing records current.

entries.title: The first curated collection
entries.summary: 72 selected resources across game and embodied research, including 49 papers and 8 original-source video demos. Eight candidate papers remain separate. Existing records use this date as the collection-history baseline.
